messages.author: f95b2ea6ae1e194d
messages.subject: problems with csvToUMF
parts:
Dear all,
I tried to transform the frog2001pcru.csv data in an unmarkedFrameOccu file, as described in the example in the help file:

> dat1 <- csvToUMF(system.file("csv","frog2001pcru.csv", package="unmarked"),  long = TRUE, type = "unmarkedFrameOccu")

So far, so good.

But if now I try to play with this data running the simplest possible model: 

>fm1<-occu(~1,~1,dat1)

I get the following error message: 

Error in occu(~1, ~1, dat1) : Data is not an unmarkedFrameOccu object.

Why is that? Anybody has any suggestion?

cheers,


Achaz von Hardenberg,

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] problems with csvToUMF
parts:
Hi Achaz,

You have an unnecessary comma in the model formula. It should be:

fm1 <- occu(~1~1, dat1)

Richard
